# Andrii Taran

> Senior Full Stack Engineer with 15+ years of experience building scalable web applications and APIs. Based in Mexico, open to remote roles in the EU, US and LATAM.

## Who I am

Andrii Taran is a Senior Full Stack Engineer specializing in React, Next.js, PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter), Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Docker, and Supabase. He has deep expertise in system architecture, API design, and performance optimization. He has worked in fully remote distributed teams since 2015 and is experienced in Agile and SCRUM methodologies.

Built dynamic PHP web applications, database integrations, frontend collaboration.
